> [!NOTE] > ## Reviews paused > > It looks like this branch is under active development. To avoid overwhelming you with review comments due to an influx of new commits, CodeRabbit has automatically paused this review. You can configure this behavior by changing the `reviews.auto_review.auto_pause_after_reviewed_commits` setting. > > Use the following commands to manage reviews: > - `@coderabbitai resume` to resume automatic reviews. > - `@coderabbitai review` to trigger a single review. > > Use the checkboxes below for quick actions: > - [ ] ▶️ Resume reviews > - [ ] 🔍 Trigger review
📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough Adds a filer-native NFS server: persistent inode sequencing and inode→path index, deterministic filehandle codec and resolver, Seaweed-backed virtual filesystem and NFS handler/server runtime, metadata invalidation follower, chunk uploader and client wiring, access allowlist, CLI command, go.mod dependency, extensive unit/integration tests, and design/dev docs. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Go module**
`go.mod`|Added `github.com/willscott/go-nfs v0.0.3` and two indirect deps for XDR / go-nfs-client.| |**CLI wiring**
`weed/command/nfs.go`, `weed/command/command.go`|New `weed nfs` command and flag parsing; starts NFS server with TLS dial options.| |**Filer inode infra & index**
`weed/filer/filer.go`, `weed/filer/filer_inode.go`, `weed/filer/filer_inode_index.go`, `weed/filer/filer_inode_index_test.go`, `weed/filer/filer_inode_test.go`|Introduced inode sequencer, ensure-assigned inodes on create/backfill on update, persisted inode→paths index with JSON upgrade, recursive collectors, and tests.| |**Filer store wrapper updates**
`weed/filer/filerstore_wrapper.go`|On successful Insert/Update/Delete/Folder-children, maintain inode index (add/remove) and use collected inode entries for deletions.| |**NFS server core & runtime**
`weed/server/nfs/server.go`, `weed/server/nfs/handler.go`, `weed/server/nfs/internal_client.go`, `weed/server/nfs/uploader.go`, `weed/server/nfs/access.go`, `weed/server/nfs/metadata_follow.go`|New Server/Option, startup/serve flow, allowlist listener, internal filer client executors, chunk uploader abstraction, metadata subscription/invalidation loop, and handler implementing mount, FSStat, handle mapping and capability negotiation.| |**Filehandle & resolver**
`weed/server/nfs/filehandle.go`, `weed/server/nfs/filehandle_test.go`|Fixed-size filehandle format (version/kind/exportID/inode/generation/CRC), decode/validation, Resolver mapping handles→paths via inode index, and unit tests for round-trips, stale/export mismatches.| |**Seaweed-backed virtual filesystem & file I/O**
`weed/server/nfs/filesystem.go`, `weed/server/nfs/handler.go`|billy Filesystem backed by filer RPCs: lookups, ReadDir, symlink/hardlink, create/mkdir/rename/remove, buffered writable semantics (inline vs chunk upload), and error translations.| |**Integration & server tests**
`weed/server/nfs/integration_test.go`, `weed/server/nfs/server_test.go`|End-to-end and unit tests with fake volume/control-plane and go-nfs-client covering mounts, authorization, inline & chunked writes, hardlinks, rename/stale-handle, metadata invalidation, and restart behavior.| |**Access control & listener**
`weed/server/nfs/access.go`|Client allowlist authorizer supporting exact hostnames, DNS resolution, and CIDR networks; allowlistListener enforces auth at Accept().| |**Metadata invalidation follower**
`weed/server/nfs/metadata_follow.go`|Background subscription to filer metadata stream, translate events→affected chunk fileIDs (deduped), and invoke chunk invalidator uncache.| |**Handler glue & filehandle mapping**
`weed/server/nfs/handler.go`, `weed/server/nfs/filehandle.go`|ToHandle/FromHandle mapping, synthetic root case, export visibility checks, and handle limit/invalidation stubs.| |**Uploader abstraction**
`weed/server/nfs/uploader.go`|`chunkUploader` interface and `operationChunkUploader` wrapper around operation.Uploader.| |**HTTP helper & usages**
`weed/util/http/http_global_client_util.go`, `weed/util/http/http_global_client_util_test.go`, `weed/filer/filechunk_manifest.go`, `weed/filer/stream.go`|Added `AppendQueryParameter` utility and tests; used to append `readDeleted=true` in chunk fetch URLs.| |**Filer rename behavior**
`weed/server/filer_grpc_server_rename.go`|Rename now handles overwrites by deleting existing target metadata/data, validating type compatibility, computing chunk diffs, and deleting obsolete chunks.| |**Docs / plans**
`weed/server/nfs/DESIGN.md`, `weed/server/nfs/DEV_PLAN.md`|Added design and dev plan documents describing architecture, phases, and known blocker (lock-state semantics).| ## Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Client as NFS Client participant Handler as NFS Handler participant Server as NFS Server participant Filer as SeaweedFiler (gRPC) participant Volume as VolumeServer (HTTP) rect rgba(200,200,255,0.5) Client->>Handler: Mount + Lookup /path/file Handler->>Server: ToHandle/FromHandle -> resolve path end rect rgba(200,255,200,0.5) Handler->>Filer: LookupDirectoryEntry /path/file Filer-->>Handler: Entry (inode, generation, chunks/inline) end alt file needs read Handler->>Volume: GET chunk(s) Volume-->>Handler: chunk bytes Handler-->>Client: READ reply else write > inline threshold Client->>Handler: WRITE (large) Handler->>Server: AssignVolume via Filer Server->>Volume: Upload chunk via uploader Volume-->>Server: fileId / ETag Server->>Filer: Update Entry with chunk fileId Handler-->>Client: WRITE reply end ``` ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~45 minutes ## Possibly related PRs - seaweedfs/seaweedfs#8854 — modifies filer rename logic and metadata-event handling; likely overlaps with rename/overwrite and metadata emission changes in this PR. > "I dug a burrow, soft and neat, > NFS handles tucked beneath my feet. > Inodes hum a steady tune, > Paths and chunks all safe by noon. > 🐰 — Celebrating new gates to the root!"
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 1 | ❌ 2 ### ❌ Failed checks (1 warning, 1 inconclusive) | Check name | Status | Explanation | Resolution | | :----------------: | :------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Docstring Coverage | ⚠️ Warning | Docstring coverage is 2.25% which is insufficient. The required threshold is 80.00%. | Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold. | | Title check | ❓ Inconclusive | The title '[nfs] Add NFS' is vague and generic. While it indicates the work is NFS-related, it does not convey the primary substantive change—that this PR adds server-side inode assignment and filer infrastructure for NFS support. | Revise the title to be more specific and descriptive of the core change, such as '[nfs] Add server-side inode assignment and filer infrastructure for NFS support' or '[filer] Add inode assignment with index foundation for NFS'. |
✅ Passed checks (1 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :---------------: | :------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | Description check | ✅ Passed | The PR description substantially covers the main changes, motivation, and validation. It follows the template structure with 'What changed', 'Why', 'Impact', and 'Validation' sections, providing sufficient detail for reviewers to understand the scope and rationale. |
✏️ Tip: You can configure your own custom pre-merge checks in the settings.
✨ Finishing Touches
🧪 Generate unit tests (beta) - [ ] Create PR with unit tests - [ ] Commit unit tests in branch `codex/nfs-inode-foundation`

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
